headline: 影剧双热：《龙族》霸榜《希望》突围
summary: 电影《希望》《生死时限》领跑热映，剧集《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续高热度，《菜鸟老警》回归受关注；待映《生化危机：爆发夜》引期待。

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》继续霸榜，讨论度飙升。
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon continues to dominate charts with soaring buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《希望》口碑领跑电影热作，成档期黑马。
industryHighlights.en: Hope leads movie buzz as a breakout hit of the season.

industryHighlights.text: 待映《生化危机：爆发夜》引发粉丝热议。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming Resident Evil: Outbreak Night sparks fan excitement.

headlineEn: Dragon House dominates, Hope breaks through
summaryEn: Movies Hope and Deadline lead the box office, while House of the Dragon stays hot on TV and The Rookie returns; Resident Evil: Outbreak Night sparks anticipation.
